message: An early start was worth it for these still reflections. Alpine air, a flask of coffee, and nowhere else to be. #Nature #Photography
The afternoon light made this quiet corner feel like a gallery. Warm wood and generous windows do most of the work. #Architecture
A few frames from a slow walk along the coast. I kept the horizon low to leave room for all that sky. #Photography
The trail was still damp from last night's rain. Everything smelled like cedar, and the only traffic was a squirrel. #Nature
Saving this palette for a watercolor study: soft blue, weathered green, and a little warm ochre. Sometimes the landscape chooses the colors. #Art
Collecting small details for the studio redesign. Clean lines, natural light, and a comfortable place to sketch. #Architecture #Art
Waited for a break in the clouds and got one good frame before the light disappeared. A reminder to keep the camera close. #Photography #Nature
Today's sketchbook exercise: reduce the shoreline to five shapes and three shades of blue. Keeping it simple is the hardest part. #Art
A little green for the end of the week. Took the long way home through the woods and left my headphones in my bag. #Nature
